resources.string: In Car hotspot mode, check when DiPlay opens or returns to the foreground. Start the saved hotspot if it is off. Keep its name and password unchanged. A system permission may be needed the first time.
Open the system permission page and allow DiPlay to modify system settings. Return to DiPlay to retry; ADB is not used.
Allow hotspot control in DiPlay Settings → Connection, then return to DiPlay.
Could not restore the car hotspot. Open car hotspot settings, then reconnect.
The permission page is unavailable. Allow DiPlay to modify system settings manually.
System-settings permission is allowed, but hotspot control was denied. Turn the hotspot on manually and export logs.
Could not access the hotspot control interface. Turn the hotspot on manually and export logs.
